antonioo_sg: Nils Antonioo arrived on Day 8 as a replacement. The men in R-S4 had been fighting for 8 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Nils Antonioo spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home found Nils Antonioo before the night shift. Nils Antonioo folded it small and kept it close.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Nils Antonioo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Nils Antonioo was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Clement Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424). Nils Antonioo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 527. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Nils Antonioo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
baronthelietch: Bastian Barontheliet unpacked his mother's thimble at R-R16. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Barontheliet let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Bastian Barontheliet held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Grey Mill has been won. Bastian Barontheliet listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
chiaroveto: Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto arrived at Q-F18 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Victory at Grey Mill. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
civo_mat: Walter Mat came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
One of the first hundred, Walter Mat was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Walter Mat caught a falling mug with his foot. Saving the mug was impressive; retrieving the foot without spilling it required assistance.
The transfer made Walter Mat a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Walter Mat approved the method. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Walter Mat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The parcel for Walter Mat contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Walter Mat saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F13 holds again. Machine-gun fire swept S-F13. Walter Mat took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Clement Tsanev of the Concord (@vl.tsanev). Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Walter Mat watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The beds were full. Walter Mat waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
The medics would not give up on Walter Mat. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F13 today.

Walter Mat drew a map of Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Lucien Raphoto never saw the shovel coming. (@r.raphoto) In the dark of the Concord trench Walter Mat hit Nils Mrpickypants with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@mrpickypants_) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Walter Mat snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Walter Mat free. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Walter Mat could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The medic cut the last bandage off Walter Mat's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F13 the same hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill has been won. Walter Mat listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
eventhatoneguywastaken: Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C8 changed before the cheering ended. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg shouldered another load.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg aimed a step ahead and fired: Karel Zzkaake, grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg is number 668. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
furry_raptor3945: Dorian "Lucky" Raptor found a place in Q-S6 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S6. Dorian "Lucky" Raptor has learned to walk bent double.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Dorian "Lucky" Raptor in the open at Q-S6. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble). Dorian "Lucky" Raptor stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-S6. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble).

Another member of the House of Raptor reached the line: Edmund Raptor. He asked where Dorian "Lucky" Raptor had slept, then chose a different corner. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Edmund Raptor read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
gagulaa__: Clement Gagulaa reached V-F11 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement Gagulaa stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
goated.josh: The new rifleman is Pavel Josh, once a postman from Rosenau. The corporal asked if a postman was any use in a trench. Pavel Josh said he would find out.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C1 with the rations. Pavel Josh ate while listening to the revised orders.

Pavel Josh tried to describe the smell of Rosenau and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Josh is number 761 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Pavel Josh watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
joey_yarrito: "You're late," said the corporal when Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Edmund Mvin was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F15 changed before the cheering ended. Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito shouldered another load.
jtall_680: Felix "Tin" Jtall signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C3 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Felix "Tin" Jtall counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Quentin Khattabka never saw the shovel coming. (@khattabka_) The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Felix "Tin" Jtall helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett and Felix "Tin" Jtall carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Felix "Tin" Jtall got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 839. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Felix "Tin" Jtall listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
living_with_wild_wolves: Emil Wolves came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Emil Wolves folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Emil Wolves was hit hard at Calvary Farm. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin.
Emil Wolves lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

The bearers moved Emil Wolves's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Emil Wolves watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
There was never a bed for Emil Wolves, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
A shell landed close to S-F7. When the dust settled Emil Wolves was still there, holding a lock of hair in a matchbox, laughing without sound.

A sniper's bullet hit Emil Wolves at S-F7. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_). The bearers reached Emil Wolves at S-F7 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).
Another member of the House of Wolves reached the line: Gideon Wolves. He asked where Emil Wolves had slept, then chose a different corner.
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Gideon Wolves and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Gideon Wolves stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Gideon Wolves borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Albin Chloe was badly wounded. Gideon Wolves got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 139. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Wolves wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
mar.stefan16: The new sniper is Quentin Stefan, once a stonemason from Stoneyford. The corporal asked if a stonemason was any use in a trench. Quentin Stefan said he would find out.

A bullet grazed Quentin Stefan's ribs at S-R11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke of the Hegemony (@broeringluke). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Stefan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The men at S-R11 heard Quentin Stefan call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Jonas Fabian of the Hegemony (@itz_fabian0120). The bearers reached Quentin Stefan at S-R11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jonas Fabian of the Hegemony (@itz_fabian0120).

The House of Stefan sent Karel Stefan after Quentin Stefan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Karel Stefan got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 827. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel Stefan watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
parker.j.mccauley: On Day 6, Karel Mccauley arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The relief column arrived early. Karel Mccauley made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A parcel from home held a comb. Karel Mccauley has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at S-S11 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix "Tin" Singh had Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Karel Mccauley was lighting a pipe. Felix "Tin" Singh let the match burn all the way down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Karel Mccauley during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Karel Mccauley fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Bastian Szko was badly wounded trying to cross it. Karel Mccauley saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S11 and fired once. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Mccauley answered to number 398. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Karel Mccauley helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
roman_askey_: Jonas "Owl" Askey unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at R-F13. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Jonas "Owl" Askey's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

Jonas "Owl" Askey got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Jonas "Owl" Askey watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The order named Jonas "Owl" Askey as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.
New laces made Jonas "Owl" Askey's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F13, Jonas "Owl" Askey listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
No post for Jonas "Owl" Askey this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.

A bullet clipped Jonas "Owl" Askey's helmet at R-F13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum). A clear shot from R-F13. Jonas "Owl" Askey grazed Wendel Green and slid back down below the parapet.
Jonas "Owl" Askey was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F13. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
The medics called Jonas "Owl" Askey 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Jonas "Owl" Askey is back on the line.

Jonas "Owl" Askey fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Severin Summer, now badly wounded. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A parcel from Ilse: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Jonas "Owl" Askey ate the cake and kept the flower in a key to a house that is no longer there's place. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
straight_dogma_son: Ulrich Son arrived at T-F18 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The new duty roster listed Ulrich Son as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F18 with the rations. Ulrich Son ate while listening to the revised orders. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich Son got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F18, Ulrich Son listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
tkendrick47: Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick arrived at R-R4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick and Silas Mcgrail split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 939. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
val_scm18: Nobody saw Pavel "Crow" Scm arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-C14, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Pavel "Crow" Scm walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Pavel "Crow" Scm left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel "Crow" Scm is number 945 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Pavel "Crow" Scm wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
